name: Community — MiniMax H3 (Video Refine)
author: LBH-123-AI + alibaba-pai + Jalen-Brunson
description: Re-render a finished MiniMax H3 clip at a higher tier without leaving H3. Drop the clip in Reference Video 1, paste the brief that made it, pick the output tier. The clip is encoded, upscaled by LBH-123-AI's trained 3D latent upscaler, then refined with Alibaba's official 8-step PDD distill at denoise 0.25 (the last two of its eight trained blocks) in 73-frame windows with 22-frame overlap, so any length up to 15 s runs in one queue. The source soundtrack is muxed back untouched; nothing is re-synthesised in the audio. Same model family as the clip, so the look, motion and cast stay H3's own. Expects 480p H3 input; it cannot repair a face the source already lost. Euler, CFG 1, 8-step grid, sigma shift 12/3, all enforced by the PDD node. Do not stack a Turbo or lightx2v LoRA in the LoRA slot.

presets.name: MiniMax H3 Video Refine (PDD 8-Step)
presets.tagline: Upscale and sharpen an H3 clip in H3 - source audio kept
presets.description: Drop a finished H3 clip in Reference Video 1 and paste the same brief that made it. Output is the clip re-rendered at the chosen tier with its own soundtrack, refined by Alibaba's official PDD 8-step distill at denoise 0.25 in 73-frame windows. Duration follows the clip (capped at 15 s); the slider is ignored. Input should be 480p H3; the upscaler targets the tier directly, so 768p is the sweet spot. Cannot repair a face the source already lost. Measured on a 12 GB RTX 4070 Ti, 864x480 in, 1344x768 out: 5 s in 162 s, 10 s in 297 s.

video.displayModel: MiniMax H3 Reference (pruned int8) + LBH 3D Latent Upscaler + Alibaba PDD Acc refine

extensions.name: rgthree-comfy
extensions.description: Power Lora Loader, used by SimpliGen's own LoRA slot. Usually pre-installed by SimpliGen.

extensions.name: ComfyUI-MiniMax-H3-PDD-Acc
extensions.description: Loads Alibaba's official PDD acceleration LoRA (trunk + parallel-decoding head bank + trained sigma schedule with partial denoise). NOT pre-installed by SimpliGen.

extensions.name: Comfyui_Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler
extensions.description: Trained 3D latent upscaler (MinimaxH3LatentUpscaler3D) and the windowed refine sampler (MMH3SplitUpscale, MMH3TemporalSplitParamsV10). Same pin as the Two-Stage pack.

extensions.name: ComfyUI-KJNodes
extensions.description: Provides PathchSageAttentionKJ for SimpliGen's Faster Attention injection (supportsSage). Not used by the graph itself.

requirements.notes: Measured 2026-09-07 on a 12 GB RTX 4070 Ti, engine ComfyUI 0.34.2, Sage attention on: 864x480 -> 1344x768, 5 s in 162 s, 10 s (two 73-frame windows, a hard cut inside the clip preserved, no visible seam) in 297 s. At native pixels the refine resolves microphone mesh, forehead lines and beard hairs that a Lanczos upscale of the same clip smears (Laplacian variance 58 against 32). Denoise 0.5 and 0.75 were also run: 0.75 adds skin texture but shifts toward a re-render and costs 268 s, so 0.25 ships. Shares the ref2va base with every R2V pack; new downloads are the 1.37 GB Ref2VA PDD distill and the 0.69 GB LBH upscaler if you lack Two-Stage. Duration follows the source clip up to 15 s. Below ~2 GB free system RAM the decode can fail with HostBuffer.read_file_slice failed.
